verdict.rationale: BVNK supports rule-based automations (e.g., POST /payment/v1/rules linking fiat accounts to crypto addresses) that execute autonomously once triggered, plus webhooks for automated event-driven notifications, which together enable background automation of payment flows. However, this is narrowly scoped to payment rule automation rather than a general-purpose agentic automation framework with scheduling, conditional logic, or multi-step orchestration. Missing for 10: evidence of a broader automation/workflow builder, scheduled triggers, or explicit AI-agent-oriented automation tooling beyond payment rules and webhooks.
